授業概要
英語コースのため、英文を参照。
This seminar on urban space and society is in total a three semester course and rotates each semester between perspectives from (1) the market (capital), (2) state governance - (3) the voluntary sector, and (4) informal communities.
This semester focuses on (1) the market (capital). For the first 3 classes we will deal with contemporary theories and methodologies on capitalist urban society. Particular attention will be given to the process of accumulation of capital and different modes of governance. For the remainder of the course, we will go through several themes, each with their own case study (with a particular focus on Asian cities). In addition, one class will be used for fieldwork (*may be adjusted).

全体の教育目標
Cities occupy a peculiar position in our society and urbanization has been at the forefront of our economic arrangements for some time now. The overall purpose of this course is to understand the role of urbanization in capitalist societies and to learn about related modes of urban governance and the social relations it shapes. As such, we will be discussing current topics like redevelopment, housing, labor, social movements etc., each from a spatial perspective.
個別の教育目標
Through the lens of the accumulation process of capital, this course introduces spatial perspectives on a range of contemporary urban social issues.
授業計画
1. Introduction
2. Theory (1): Theoretic approaches to urban space
3. Theory (2): Methodological approaches to urban space
4. Urban governance (1): The spatial management of labor (Anti-urbanism in Flanders, Belgium)
5. Urban governance (2): Economic restructuring and urban politics (Hong Kong as a world city)
6. Cities and housing (1): Housing markets (Private low-rent housing in Hong Kong)
7. Cities and housing (2): Population movement and migration (Foreign workers in Singapore)
8. Course summary and final report assignments
キーワード
Cities, society, accumulation of capital, globalization, governance, social movements
